notes.title: New Teaser Trailer for Rise of Peles
notes.content:
The new trailer is now live!

Embark on a dark journey in Rise Of Peles, blending deep RPG gameplay, epic combat, and innovative crafting automation with a unique vampire lore.

Set in a rich, dark fantasy world, this game invites players to explore, fight, and strategize like never before. Don't miss our trailer release event on Steam, showcasing the thrilling adventures that await. Join us to discover the secrets of Peles and prepare to be immersed in a game that promises to captivate and challenge you in equal measure.

Watch the trailer here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZLvLMu1QEpA
